note: Runtime assets of the 2.5D presentation: assets25d/models/*.glb (Blender scripts in this branch, textured with CC0 Poly Haven scans and procedural maps), assets25d/impostors/*.webp (Cycles renders of CC0 tree scans) and assets25d/ph/ (CC0 Poly Haven HDRIs/textures fetched by visual25d/tools/polyhaven.py, gitignored). The characters and objects depict Nintendo-owned designs (Super Mario Bros.): the modelling is original, but the IP is not open; treat the build like the rest of this private recreation (no publishing).

tools.name: meshoptimizer
